acceptance: RED first: a document lane whose advisor plan says tdd=false does not dispatch tdd, recorded with a clamp or reason naming the release
A code lane's plan-time tdd force is unchanged
fix: Either raise router_replan to advisory once a soak shows re-plans are sound, or let a floor-forced tdd entry lapse at tdd's turn when the pin is released and the advisor's original plan did not run it (record which entries the floor forced).
summary: ClampPlanToFloorWith evaluates TddPinned with empty signals at cycle start, so ship-requires-tdd forces tdd into every initial plan; after scout declares deliverable_kind=document the pin is released, but the walk follows the clamped plan and router_replan is shadow. The advisor, now shown the lane's document item, cannot opt it out. item_count was the blocker to raising the re-plan and is fixed (2026-10-01).
title: A document lane always runs tdd on the plan path: the plan-time floor forces it with empty signals and only the shadow re-plan could release it
